BearerAuth.description: Joomla API token of a user, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Users get their token on the Joomla API Token tab of their profile. The plugins "API Authentication - Web Services Joomla Token" and "User - Joomla API Token" must be enabled.

JoomlaToken.name: X-Joomla-Token
JoomlaToken.description: The same API token in the `X-Joomla-Token` header. Joomla tries to extract a Bearer token first and reads this header when the extracted token is empty. A non-empty Bearer token takes precedence even when authentication fails.

BasicAuth.description: Username and password of a user. Only works when the plugin "API Authentication - Web Services Basic Auth" is enabled, which it is not by default.

JUpdateToken.name: X-JUpdate-Token
JUpdateToken.description: Update token of the Joomla Automated Updates service, set in the options of Joomla Update. Only used by the `/v1/joomlaupdate` endpoints.
